_bough.how: Each part is drawn pointing right from its pivot to its joint. Walk a pose's chain: the first part's pivot on the frame's bough point (raised by the pose's rise, as the frame is), turned to its angle; each next part's pivot on the last one's joint (length units along its angle), turned to its own angle. A strike (extend) runs level along its band: add level bough2 copies before the hand until it reaches the far wall. Facing left (her arena): flip each part's sprite like the body (scale.x < 0) and turn it by -angle; the next joint is then length / 2 px along (-cos a, sin a). Draw them over the body (the near arm). Only the sweep frames leave the arm out: every other frame draws its own. thick: scale each part's sprite across its length by it (scale.y; the high sweep lashes a thinner bough). A strike's hurt band is hurt_px tall round band_px (its centre, px over the floor). Low 15 px, 28 px tall: jump it (its art -1..31 px). High 86 px, 16 px tall (78..94 px): its art (76.4..95.6 px) passes over a standing Waxby's candle flame (66..80 px by calling: only the Taperwitch's and the Sexton's tallest flicker grazes it) and under a row-10 ledge's top (96 px): stay down, or stand on a ledge.

sweep_high_strike.what: lashed over a standing Waxby: the band's centre 86 px up (its art 76.4..95.6 px: over his flame, under a row-10 ledge)

sweep_high_strike_p3.what: P3: lashed over a standing Waxby (86 px)

sweep_high_tell.what: the arm rears up over her head, the hand high and cocked back

sweep_high_tell_p3.what: P3: the arm rears up over her head

sweep_low_strike.what: lashed along the floor: the band's centre 15 px up

sweep_low_strike_p3.what: P3: slammed down from the lifted shoulder and lashed along the floor (15 px)

sweep_low_tell.what: the arm drops low from her hip and lies back along the floor, the hand cocked behind her

sweep_low_tell_p3.what: P3: the arm drops from her lifted hip and lies back low along the floor

_doc: Mother Gravebough's 384-unit frames: 2 units = 1 world px, drawn facing right (flip her in the arena), anchor (her root line) at (192, 368). World offset = (point - anchor) / 2 px, mirrored with the facing. heart = the caged ember (in _die the heart blooming in her crown); eye_l, eye_r = her glowing eye slits; face = the face (chip target); mouth = where Spore Breath comes out; crown = the crown (Seedfall shakes it; the skull seeds fall from it); bough = the near shoulder, where rootmother_bough1's pivot goes; trunk = her body box [x, y, w, h] (touch and chip hits; not the arms).

_p3.how: P3 "Deep Roots" (spec 5.2: she tears her lower roots out and her trunk rises a tile). From the P3 roar on, draw EVERY frame (the roar's rootmother_bare included) rise_px higher than her anchor, and rootmother_legs behind it with its anchor (192, 112) on her anchor: her own roots then hang over the stilt legs like a skirt. Every tell keeps its frame (the sweeps, dig, breath, hurt, wilt), so nothing pops. Every point of a frame moves up by rise units with it; the bough uses the *_p3 poses (from the lifted shoulder). The roar: show rootmother_bare and ease the rise from 0 to rise_px over it (the legs appear from under her as she lifts); rootmother_bare, lifted, also suits the Thorn Crown tell (arms up, the crown shaking). Her touch box in P3 is the frame's trunk box lifted, plus legs_box (legs part units, the stilts; about 32 px tall) over the floor. On a retry she is rooted again (rise 0, no legs).

_placement.how: Where to root her in R_ARENA (spec 3.4.4: her trunk is the wall columns 28..35, rooted into the right quarter): her anchor 48 px right of the right wall's face (x 896, the left edge of col 28), so x 944 (29.5 tiles), on the floor (row 13's top), facing left. Then her trunk box begins 5 px in front of the wall face (chip hits reach it from the floor), her far side ends over col 32, and her nearest reach (a hand on the floor, 95 px ahead of the anchor) stops at x 849, 17 px clear of the col-25 vine lane (and under the V2 socket at (26, 6) by 28 px). The bough starts at the wall face (the sweep frames' bough point, 47 px ahead) and extends about 12 segments to the far wall. Do not anchor her on the map's X (27, 12): there her near hand crosses the vine. At 1:1 she is 173 x 186 px (5.4 x 5.8 tiles), not the 8-tile trunk the arena map draws: see A4's request to W0 (keep 1:1; her roots can fill the rest of the wall in the arena art).

bloom_bud.note: pale on purpose: modulate it toward amber (about Color(1.0, 0.72, 0.42)) for the target's blush

bloom_decoy.note: unlit: give it no light; breathe it with a scale pulse, never a glow

bloom_open.note: the blossom box (28 x 28 px) is box; the heart glows at center (a light r 40..70 there)

root_hump.note: a solid block one tile tall (32 px) and 60 px wide, nothing to pass under: body

root_spear.note: the 26 x 64 px pillar is body (the whole frame high); its one-way ledge is its cap, the top of body

thorn.note: points down; turn it to its fall

_sockets.floor: a floor or ledge socket (F1, F2, L1, L2): the bloom's base on the top of the solid cell under the anchor cell, at the cell's centre x
_sockets.vine: a vine socket (V1, V2): the bloom's center on the anchor cell's centre
